title: Team status and routing
description: Live agent status and load, automatic routing rules, capacity limits and routing history.
toast.failed: Could not complete the action. Try again.
limits.title: Default capacity
limits.hint: Maximum open conversations per agent. A channel limit counts that channel, "All" counts every conversation; empty = unlimited, 0 = no new conversations.
settings.enabled_hint: New unassigned conversations go to available agents.
settings.vip: VIP companies to their account owner
settings.vip_hint: When the company's account owner is available, they get the conversation.
settings.offline_hint: Conversations waiting on an agent who goes offline move to someone else.
rules.title: Routing rules
rules.hint: The first matching rule sends the conversation to a team queue or requires skills.
rules.empty: No rules; all agents take conversations from one pool.
rules.name: Rule name
